verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform that ships web and mobile SDKs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only covers verification flows, screening, monitoring, team access management and documentation probes. Nothing documents disabling telemetry, analytics or usage tracking in the dashboard, SDKs or API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
